name: slack-reaction-inbound
description: M19 U7 (X-rider W2): parity twin of telegram/reaction-steer on a DIFFERENT adapter. A ✅ slack reaction (reaction_added, normalized) in a mention-gated slack channel bypasses the gate (interaction payload) and persists a non-trigger content.reaction row (kind=chat, trigger=0, pending for the runner's R2 steering seam); no runner turn, no outbound, no delivery. Proves the inbound → router reaction leg is channel-agnostic — it works for slack's identity/target shape, not just telegram's.
